name: Configuration Management
description: Create and manage Windows configuration policies through scheduled Action1 automations.

actions.label: Get Control Pack
actions.description: Loads the installed Configuration Manager Control Pack catalog.

actions.label: Get Policy
actions.description: Loads one persisted Configuration Manager policy.

actions.label: Get Overview
actions.description: Loads current Configuration Manager Overview data for the future Overview surface.

actions.label: Save Policy
actions.description: Creates or updates the persisted Configuration Manager policy record.

actions.label: Policy created
actions.description: Creates and initially applies a Configuration Manager Policy.

actions.label: Policy updated
actions.description: Updates and applies a Configuration Manager Policy.

actions.label: Set Policy Enabled
actions.description: Enables or disables a persisted Configuration Manager policy.

actions.label: Policy disabled
actions.description: Disables a Configuration Manager Policy and removes its owned automations.

actions.label: Policy enabled
actions.description: Enables a Configuration Manager Policy and recreates its owned automations.

actions.label: Delete Policy
actions.description: Deletes a persisted Configuration Manager policy.

actions.label: Discover Policy Organizations
actions.description: Loads Action1 organizations for the Configuration Manager Policies wizard.

actions.label: Discover Policy Endpoint Groups
actions.description: Loads Action1 endpoint groups for the selected Configuration Manager organization.

actions.label: Scheduled reconciliation
actions.description: Reconciles missing owned Action1 automations for Enabled Policies.

actions.label: Get Reporting State
actions.description: Loads persisted Configuration Management reporting identities without remote verification.

actions.label: Reporting setup
actions.description: Creates or repairs the Configuration Management Data Source and Reports.
